title: X aims to safely land Starship and booster stage after orbital flight | New Scientist
description: The upcoming Starship test flight is the most ambitious to date and, if successful, will mark an important milestone in the company's mission to create a truly reusable launch vehicle that dramatically lowers the cost of space launches
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Re-analysis of black hole data proves iconic ring shape really is there | New Scientist
description: The doughnut shape of the Event Horizon Telescope’s first image of a black hole has come under fire, but an independent check showed that it – and general relativity – still stands
author: Leah Crane

title: Revised approach for assessing obesity improves on BMI | New Scientist
description: Using data from more than 800,000 people, researchers have tested a system that can identify those with obesity who would benefit from treatment, and those who don't require intervention
author: Starre Vartan

title: Correcting quantum computer errors may be more complicated than expected | New Scientist
description: Correcting quantum computer errors is key for making the devices practical, but some types of errors, and the complications they could introduce, may be more likely to occur than we had thought
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan

title: What is the electrification target at COP31 and can countries meet it? | New Scientist
description: The world will need to quadruple its pace on electrification to meet the target being pushed by the COP31 presidency this week, but increasingly affordable renewable energy could put the goal within reach
author: Shosha Adie

title: Newly described insect may live its whole life on a spider's web | New Scientist
description: A species of “web-loving bug” from China lives on a spider's web and seems to follow its arachnid host around. The insect may be too small for the spider to bother attacking
author: Jake Buehler
